svg.title: P2WPKH address construction
svg.desc: Bob's public key goes through HASH160, SHA256 then RIPEMD160, to give a 20-byte public-key hash, which becomes the witness program. A Bech32 bracket groups prepending witness version 0, regrouping the witness version and witness program into 33 values of 5 bits, calculating a 6-value checksum over bc and those values, appending it, and writing bc1 followed by one character per value, which gives an address beginning with bc1q.

text.tspan: Write bc1, then one character per value
